title: Riga Art Nouveau Centre website
lede: The Riga museum’s site crowns a plain blue-and-white layout with a drawn header of Jugendstil masks and flared lettering.
summary: Drawn Jugendstil header with masks and hand-lettered name, over a blue and white serif layout.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. A cookie notice covers the bottom sixth of the viewport.

styles.note: Borderline: the header is a drawn Art Nouveau facade ornament with flared hand lettering, but the rest of the page is a plain blue grid.

observed: The header is a blue line drawing on pale blue of two large female masks with stylized hair, flanking a dark blue panel with “RĪGAS JŪGENDSTILA CENTRS” in hand-drawn, flared capitals and a curling ornament below.
The navigation sits on white in a serif (Lora), in mid-blue capitals separated by small snowflake-like ornaments.
The main area is a photograph of the museum’s spiral staircase with painted Art Nouveau wall decoration, next to a dark blue information column.
Two overlay labels in yellow serif with yellow triangles sit over the photograph.
A cookie notice covers the bottom sixth of the viewport.
interpretation: Only the header and the photograph carry the style. The blue palette is closer to the Riga facades than to the grammar’s moss and ochre.
Measured: square boxes (radius median 0), 1 px borders on half the boxes, no shadows, two colour families, and accent chroma 0.52.
borrow: Draw the site header as a line illustration in one colour and set the name inside it in hand-drawn flared capitals.
Separate navigation items with a small ornament instead of a bar.

images.alt: Riga Art Nouveau Centre home page: a blue line-drawn header with two stylized masks and hand-lettered museum name, a serif navigation bar, a photograph of a painted spiral staircase, and a dark blue information column.
images.caption: First viewport of [jugendstils.riga.lv](https://jugendstils.riga.lv/).
